revela_stereo.description: Two eyes, each the standard ISP: raw Bayer in, linear RGB out, per eye. The ISP is described once, as bayer_isp, and instantiated twice. Every block inside still gets its own instance path and its own base address -- left.ccm and right.ccm are independent registers, so each eye is tuned on its own -- and the emitted RTL is one module per block, instantiated per eye, instead of two identical copies.

bit_depth.description: Depth samples arrive at, on both eyes.

max_width.description: Widest frame either eye may carry: what the demosaic's line buffers are sized from.

max_height.description: Tallest frame either eye may carry.

inputs.name: left_sensor
inputs.description: Raw Bayer from the left sensor.

inputs.name: right_sensor
inputs.description: Raw Bayer from the right sensor.

outputs.name: left_video
outputs.description: Linear RGB from the left eye: R low, G mid, B high.

outputs.name: right_video
outputs.description: Linear RGB from the right eye.

right.description: The right eye: its own white balance and colour matrix, since the eyes may not see the same illuminant.
